# Workflow Lifecycle Retirement Continuity Instrument

This directory is repository shared control-plane infrastructure. It is a fail-closed evidence classifier for the registered workflow lifecycle retirement continuity gap.

It creates no physical-retirement, gap-registry mutation, merge, workflow-mutation, product-mutation, or semantic authority. The verifier may emit `PASS_CLOSED_ELIGIBLE` only when all six canonical evidence classes are present, signal normalization is valid, unresolved consumer count is zero, and all authority-effect flags remain false.

A candidate receipt is evidence for a separately admitted ratification/closure operation; it is not itself gap closure.
